Enrich person.title: Head of Service Operations, SurePayroll by Paychex
Enrich person.summary:
The most successful organizations don’t happen by accident—they’re built through exceptional leadership, empowered people, a commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and a relentless focus on delivering meaningful value and exceptional customer experiences. That’s the work I’m passionate about.

For more than 20 years, I’ve helped organizations build, transform, and scale customer service, customer experience, contact center, customer success, and sales operations. Throughout my career, I’ve progressed from operational leadership into strategic leadership roles, partnering with senior leaders to modernize operations, improve customer outcomes, and build high-performing teams that deliver measurable business results.

I believe customer service is one of an organization’s greatest competitive advantages. When strategy, people, technology, and culture are aligned, organizations strengthen customer loyalty, improve employee engagement, and create sustainable growth.

My experience spans business transformation, AI-enabled customer operations, digital-first service strategies, workforce optimization, organizational design, budgeting and P&L management, and performance optimization. I leverage analytics, collaboration, and continuous improvement to solve complex business challenges and build scalable, customer-centric organizations.

Selected Business Outcomes

• Reduced customer churn by 25%, strengthening customer loyalty and retention.

• Increased Net Promoter Score (NPS) by 30 points through customer experience transformation.

• Delivered $5.9M in annual operational savings through workforce optimization and process improvement.

• Improved service levels from 58% to 84% while increasing workforce productivity and customer satisfaction.

• Led startup, turnaround, and enterprise transformation initiatives that positioned organizations for sustainable growth.

• Built high-performing leadership teams through coaching, accountability, succession planning, and talent development.

• Leveraged AI, automation, analytics, and digital-first strategies to reduce contact volume, modernize customer operations, and enhance both customer and employee experiences.

My leadership philosophy is simple: exceptional customer experiences begin with exceptional employee experiences. I believe organizations achieve their best results when leaders invest in people, empower teams, and foster cultures built on trust, accountability, and continuous improvement.
